Elden Ring early weapon upgrades at Church of Elleh

Game: Elden Ring.

In early Elden Ring, weapon upgrades improve your weapon at the smithing table inside Church of Elleh. Spend runes and ordinary Smithing Stones to reinforce an eligible weapon there. The Church of Elleh table supports only the first few reinforcement levels. This nearby base-game weapon-improvement step is available before leaving Limgrave. Inspect the reinforcement screen for the material cost before spending runes.
